clue.text: Vermouth knocked back, sensible drink

indicators.note: knocking back a drink tips it up, so the word for vermouth is read backwards

parts.note: IT is short for Italian vermouth, as in gin and it
sensible means sane

explanation.surface: Someone downs a vermouth and then switches to something sensible to drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Knocked back' turns IT (Italian vermouth) into TI.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbal infusion is a drink, so the definition is a plain hypernym of the herbal tea.

clue.text: Knight is buried in the church for that reason

indicators.note: is buried in says the knight's letter goes inside

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A knight lies buried in the church for some reason.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic adverb meaning therefore, as a consequence.

clue.text: Like sheep and goats with destinies unalike ultimately (Bible story)

indicators.note: ultimately points to the end letters of the two words before it

parts.note: a parable is a story told by Jesus in the Bible

explanation.surface: The Gospel story where sheep and goats meet differing fates.
explanation.walkthrough: In Matthew 25 sheep are divided from goats at the Last Judgement, so the two flocks can be told apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that can be divided or told apart, as the flocks are at judgement.

clue.text: In agitated state over silly group of students outside

indicators.note: outside says the students' group wraps around the other letters

parts.note: NUS is the National Union of Students

indicators.note: silly signals the letters of over are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone gets worked up over a foolish student gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'silly' makes ERVO from OVER, held 'outside' by NUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Being anxious or jittery is an agitated state.

clue.text: Relation, terribly hot inside, gets to strip

indicators.note: inside says the shuffled letters go within the relative's word

parts.note: an uncle is a relation

indicators.note: terribly signals the letters of hot are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A relative gets overheated and starts taking clothes off.
explanation.definitionFit: To strip someone is to undress them, removing their garments.

clue.text: Like some silly poetry — no lines scan, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Silly verse whose lines regrettably fail to scan.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward Lear's 'nonsense verse' is the reference.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonsense verse, such as Lear's, is absurd or meaningless poetry.

clue.text: Six feet under — or heading that way?

definitions.text: Six feet under — or heading that way?

parts.words: Six feet under — or heading that way?
parts.note: buried in a grave, or brought down by illness, close to death

explanation.surface: Someone dead and buried, or about to be.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means struck down by illness, or literally put in a grave.

clue.text: Number performing — such may be in the groove

definitions.text: such may be in the groove

parts.note: ten is a number
on means on stage, performing

explanation.surface: A musical number is played in a good rhythm.
explanation.definitionFit: A projecting piece of wood shaped to fit a slot or mortise in a joint.

clue.text: Trying to convey excited 'yes' with a sign

indicators.note: excited suggests agitated letters that are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone attempts to signal an eager yes with a gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: To essay is to attempt, so the participle means attempting.

clue.text: No longer left with something to sell abroad

parts.note: ex- means former, no longer
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A trader no longer has stock left to sell overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods shipped to foreign markets for sale are called by this noun.

clue.text: An insect disturbed people years ago

indicators.note: disturbed suggests the letters of an insect are stirred up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone disturbs a bug, which bothers the people around.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancients are the peoples of antiquity, those who lived long ago.

clue.text: Worry about a little container for firework explosive

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the worry word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: worry means care
a touch means a little, a small amount

explanation.surface: A fretful person worries over a small box holding gunpowder for fireworks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A little' looks like a size for the container, but it is a touch, a small amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartouche is a paper case holding the charge of a firework or cartridge.

clue.text: Hippie cells will have this important feature

definitions.text: Hippie cells will have this important feature

parts.words: Hippie cells will have this important feature
parts.note: the middle of the two words hippie and cells holds a run of five letters meaning a bit, so the phrase describes where that bit sits

explanation.surface: Hippie communes have a key element at their heart.
explanation.walkthrough: Look at the middle of the words 'Hippie cells': the letters P-I-E-C-E sit there, so those cells literally have a piece in the centre, read as one phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A focal or principal item, such as the decoration in the middle of a table.

clue.text: Island lady wants French article rather than English one

indicators.note: wants here means requires, calling for a swap of letters
rather than says one article takes the place of the other

parts.note: a is the English indefinite article
un is the French indefinite article

explanation.surface: An islander lady chooses French grammar over English.
explanation.walkthrough: In LADY the English article A is replaced by the French article UN. Lundy is an island in the Bristol Channel off Devon, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Lundy is a small island in the Bristol Channel, an example of the category named.

clue.text: More than one female professional wins me bonuses, working

indicators.note: working signals the letters are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A boast that working earns bonuses.
explanation.definitionFit: Women in commerce or executive roles are professionals; the plural matches 'more than one'.

clue.text: Came across city, keeping on, as one having regular beat

parts.note: met means came across, encountered

indicators.note: keeping means holding within, so the city surrounds the word on

parts.note: Rome is a city

explanation.surface: Someone met a city and kept a steady beat.
explanation.definitionFit: A device that ticks at a set tempo for musicians, so has a regular beat.

clue.text: Played with IT, like groups at schools?

definitions.meaning: broadcast over the internet with information technology, as video is
pupils divided into ability sets are put in streams

explanation.surface: Someone fiddled with computers like a school group.
explanation.definitionFit: Video sent over the internet live is streamed; pupils sorted by ability are streamed.

clue.text: Rescues the art neglected in a valuable box

indicators.note: neglected suggests the letters have fallen into disarray and need rearranging

explanation.surface: Someone saves a neglected artwork found in a precious box.
explanation.definitionFit: A strongbox holding treasure is a box of valuable contents.

clue.text: Shivery nudes beginning to edge away — now possibly?!

definitions.text: Shivery nudes beginning to edge away — now possibly?!

indicators.note: shivery suggests the letters are trembling into a new order
away means removed, so the letter goes from the nudes
beginning to picks the first letter of edge
possibly suggests a rearrangement of the letters of now

explanation.surface: Naked bathers start shivering and edging off as the sun goes.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing E from NUDES leaves NUDS, 'Shivery' makes SUND, and 'possibly' turns NOW into OWN. The whole clue pictures the cooling evening.
explanation.definitionFit: At dusk the air cools, so it is the time naturists start to shiver and leave.

clue.text: Top lady — see me turn up with crowd following

indicators.note: following means coming after the other piece
turn up in a down clue means read upward, backwards

parts.note: a press is a crowd or throng

explanation.surface: A grand lady tells you to watch her arrive with a throng behind.
explanation.definitionFit: A female ruler of an empire is the highest-ranking lady.

clue.text: Group of stars with yen to hide in the underworld

indicators.note: to hide in means put out of sight within

parts.note: Hades is the Greek underworld
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: Stars who keep their money hidden underground.
explanation.definitionFit: A star cluster in the constellation Taurus, so a group of stars.

clue.text: What breakfast menu may have, creating stir

definitions.meaning: a cooked breakfast menu might list an ... toast, read here as two words
to stir someone up is to urge or incite them

explanation.surface: A breakfast menu item that is stirred up.
explanation.definitionFit: To urge or incite someone is to stir them up; a menu might offer egg on toast.

clue.text: Grand Old Man embracing the Parisian dolt

indicators.note: embracing means holding within

parts.note: GOM is short for Grand Old Man, Gladstone's nickname
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A grand old statesman hugs a French fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A golem is a lumbering clay figure, hence a stupid person, a blockhead.

clue.text: Old college not genuine? Conflicting noises perhaps here?

parts.note: a poly was a British polytechnic, a type of college abolished in 1992
phony means fake, not genuine

explanation.surface: A sneer at a fake old college where noise clashes.
explanation.definitionFit: Music with several independent melodic lines sounding together can seem like clashing voices.

clue.text: This writer was first to admit depression and softened

parts.note: this writer is the setter, me

indicators.note: to admit means to let in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: led means was in front, was first
a low is an area of low pressure, a depression

explanation.surface: A writer confesses depression first and becomes gentler.
explanation.definitionFit: Becoming gentler or less harsh with age is to mellow; the past tense matches.

clue.text: Mo's support

definitions.meaning: mo is short for moment, a very brief time
to support a motion is to back it formally

explanation.surface: Someone named Mo is providing support.
explanation.definitionFit: A moment is a brief time; to back a proposal formally is the same verb.

clue.text: Mad chaps beginning to talk, interrupting performance

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into, so these pieces go inside the other

parts.note: a deed is an act, a performance
chaps are men

indicators.note: beginning to picks out the first letter of talk

explanation.surface: Crazed men start chatting in the middle of a show.
explanation.definitionFit: Insane or out of one's mind, a synonym for mad.

clue.text: Plants with bosses laying off a thousand

indicators.note: laying off means dismissing, so a letter is dropped from the bosses

parts.note: masters are bosses
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Factory bosses lay off a thousand workers.
explanation.definitionFit: Asters are daisy-like flowering plants, an example of the category.
